source.note: Built 2026-10-21 from the reformatted Grade 7 Mathematics course (07Mathematics Q3-Q4 Module Formatted folders). Module and item titles, order, sub-headers, points, grading types, submission types and Wiris LTI links (quiz id + lookup uuid) were read from the product master copy export (7th-grade-math-product-master-copy-export.imscc): the course was never deployed to Canvas the old way and has no Module Maps in the formatted set, so the export is the naming authority. The 24 student-facing Prior Knowledge Checks sit in the export's Teacher Resources buckets (published per the reformat decision); here each is placed before the lesson it supports and excluded from the final grade (course owner's decision). The four Module Lesson Maps pages are in an unpublished Teacher Resources module. Lessons and assignment pages are on https://optimaondemand.github.io/mj-grade-7-mathematics. Gradebook groups and weights (40/40/20) from the course owner; the course's teacher manual recommends 60/30/10. No week pacing exists in the course files, so no item carries a week.
